# Data Provenance & Assumptions

**All data is synthetic**, generated by `scripts/generate_data.py` (seed 7). No real company, customer or platform data.

| Area | How it is generated |
|---|---|
| Market | 16 German states weighted by population and urban share; Jan–Jun 2025 with a spring uplift |
| Spend | Daily budgets by platform, split across states by population with noise; budgets rise from April |
| Orders | Baseline demand (direct, organic, brand intent, email, affiliate) plus incremental orders from paid media with diminishing returns. The true effect of each channel is not stored anywhere; it can only be estimated |
| Customers | New and returning customers; returning share grows over time; 58% opt in to email |
| GA4 | Only ~72% of orders have consented journeys; daily traffic is aggregated GA4-style; conversion paths include up to three touches within 14 days |
| Platforms | Report delivery exactly, but claim conversions generously (click and view windows), so totals exceed real orders |
| Affiliate | Network-reported orders and revenue; cost is a 10% commission |
| Costs | COGS ~24–30% of revenue; shipping €4.20–4.90; payment fees 1.9% + €0.25; ~4% returns, ~3% cancellations |
| Geo test | Meta paused in 8 treatment states, 5 May – 1 June 2025 (see geo_test_design.md) |

**Limitations:** no impression-level or view-through data; journeys are stylised; Google's modelled conversions and
platform attribution windows are simplified; 16 states is a small number of test units, so geo results carry real uncertainty.
